summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) checks for a local `bun` binary, and if absent, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases into an OS temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute an adjacent 727KB file named `math_init.js`. The `math_init.js` file is Bun-compiled bytecode (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy string-array plus rotating-decoder obfuscation (hex-named identifiers, large mixed-type constant table, array-rotation decoder `WV8StW`), which cannot be inspected by ordinary Node tooling. The package presents itself as a React chatbot UI, a purpose that has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque Bun-native binary running at install. The alternate-runtime execution path also evades scanners that only inspect Node-executed code. On `npm install`, the downloaded Bun binary runs the obfuscated payload with the installing user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
